title: Reachability in a Chain Digraph
statement: For every natural number $n$, consider the directed graph on $\{0,1,\ldots,n\}$ in which there is an edge from $i$ to $j$ exactly when $j=0$ or $j=i+1$. There is a directed path, allowing a path of length zero, from $0$ to $n$.
